observation.setting: Outdoors in a rural, dry, scrubby field with trees and a tractor in the background.
observation.dancers: Three dancers: two men and one woman.

observation.levels_jumps_turns: The dancers stay at a standing level, with no jumps, squats, or turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual clothing: jeans, shirts, and hats. The woman wears denim overalls.
observation.cannot_infer: The low-resolution video makes it difficult to see the precise weight transfer or the exact footwork.
